text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Tulip Sho... A 1,600m race just like 
the Oka Sho, the first crown of the Tiara 
line, making it a crucial prep race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are still many unstable elements to 
Still in Love's instinct... To check on 
that, we made a sudden decision to enter 
the race.
choice_data_list:
Does everything seem okay with your 
condition?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am nervous. I feel like... I am 
receiving praise that I do not deserve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, following her running up to 
this point, she had become a hot topic 
among the spectators as an 'interesting 
girl,' and her popularity was rapidly 
rising.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The journalists' coverage is brimming with 
passion; one can feel their massive 
expectations for Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... if I ended up 
betraying everyone's expectations?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: As you are now, you're sure to win.
As you are now, you can definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Go on out there with confidence

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...If you'd go so far as to say that for 
me, Trainer...!"
